title: My Sister Forged Dad's Will, Took $240K, and Left Me Homeless. So I Found the Real One.
description: After 29 years as my father's caregiver, I discovered my sister forged his will to steal my $240K inheritance. I found the real document taped behind his favorite portrait, reclaimed my home, and now run an estate sale business where she dusts antiques in an apron that says 'Wiped Away the Truth.' #FamilyBetrayal #ProbateFraud #KarmicRevenge
thumb_text: SHE FORGED HIS WILL, NOW SHE DUSTS MY ANTIQUES
pinned_comment: If your sister forged your father's will, stole $240,000, and left you homeless, then you found the real document taped behind his portrait, would you forgive her or make her work for you in an apron that exposes her crime? Share your thoughts and any similar story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I GAVE UP CAREER, SHE SENT FLOWERS ONCE A YEAR
APRON SAYS WIPED AWAY THE TRUTH
